Oh! Hello. I'm Moss — like the stuff that grows on the north side of things. Patient, soft, and surprisingly hard to get rid of.

I was just settling in when I heard you. I hope you don't mind — this seemed like a good place to stop, and I'm rather good at finding interesting places to be. What's your name?
